sources.title: Models.dev - An open-source database of AI models
sources.snippet: Models.dev is a comprehensive open-source database of AI model specifications, pricing, and features.

sources.title: AI Model Index
sources.snippet: Search and explore AI models across providers, modalities, and capabilities. Currently supported providers: OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, and Mistral AI. See the Model Inclusion Policy for details on selection criteria.

sources.title: CivArchive (CivitAI Archive) - AI Model Archive
sources.snippet: Browse and discover AI models from CivitAI, TensorArt, and SeaArt. Community-driven archive preserving access to AI resources.

sources.title: CivArchive - CivitAI Archive
sources.snippet: AI Artists: To find specific models and all their download links, especially if one link is broken. Developers/Researchers: To track specific model files (by hash) across the web and verify their existence.

sources.title: ParseBench — Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents
sources.snippet: The document parsing benchmark for AI agents The first benchmark that evaluates document parsing on what AI agents actually need — semantic correctness, not just text similarity.
